subject.title: fix(googlechat): fall back to text link when remote media upload fails with 403

question: Which open Google Chat app-auth media fallback PR should maintainers repair and treat as the canonical implementation for the linked issue?
rationale: This member-authored PR is a useful candidate but is conflicting and overlaps with other open implementations, so a maintainer should choose the branch to refresh before repair or merge.

options.title: Repair this member PR
options.body: Refresh this PR against current main, narrow the upload-403 detector, preserve action metadata, and use it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Choose another open PR
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer another sibling implementation that can be refreshed to cover the same three media paths safely.

options.title: Defer to OAuth direction
options.body: Keep the fallback issue open but delay landing until maintainers decide it should be folded into the broader delegated user-OAuth work.

recommendation.title: Repair this member PR
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR against current main, narrow the upload-403 detector, preserve action metadata, and use it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat API/action/media history makes this the best available routing owner for choosing the canonical fix shape.
